arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by adding two steps after the initial regex substitution: (1) collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one with `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`, and (2) strip leading/trailing hyphens with `text.strip("-")`. This ensures `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello-world"` instead of `"hello--world-"`, and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"` instead of `"-a-b-"`.
